title: Citus: operator COPY round-trip backup of the distributed dataset
description: Runs `nexus backup take citus`: the operator (nexus-cluster-admin) streams `COPY (...) TO STDOUT` for the reference `tenants`, the distributed `events`, and the colocated `event_tags` via the coordinator VIP — pulling the distributed rows out through the coordinator — into gzip archives node-local on the coordinator.

observe.what: /var/backups/nexus-citus/<id>/{tenants,events,event_tags}.csv.gz node-local on the coordinator; ~5.5 KiB total

whatProves: CitusAdapter.BackupTakeAsync uses the operator credential to COPY each table TO STDOUT through the coordinator (a client-side pull, no superuser needed), fanning the distributed events/event_tags rows out to the workers via the coordinator's operator .pgpass.
